title: Reinforced Netherrack
description: This add a reinforced netherrack and a new villager profession
body:
A mod who add a new block : The Reinforced Netherrack, it also add a new trade and profession with the Reinforced Netherrack. Now you can can craft the Reinforced Deepslate.
### Available in Neoforge with the versions 1.21.8-1.21.11
